intro: Persistent teams of agents with a lead, members and default policies. Assign a team to this project, then let the Manager delegate a plan to it.

empty.title: No teams yet
empty.description: Create a team from agent templates: pick a lead, executors and a reviewer, and bound its fan-out, attempts and budget.

confirmDelete: Delete the team "{{name}}"? Its assignments are removed too.
scopeHint: Team agents never see secrets of other projects.

tree.label: Team hierarchy
tree.empty: No delegated tasks yet. When the Manager delegates a plan to this team, its lead splits each task for the executors here.
tree.noLead: This team has no lead: the Manager gives each task to one member directly.

editor.subtitle: Members come from agent templates. The lead decomposes delegated tasks; executors do them; a reviewer checks the result.
editor.name: Name
editor.hierarchy: Hierarchy: the lead decomposes each task for executors
editor.hierarchyHint: Needs a lead and at least one executor. Depth is bounded: Manager → lead → executors.
editor.requireReview: A reviewer checks the combined result

validation.name: The name must be 1–{{max}} characters.
validation.description: The description must be at most {{max}} characters.
validation.oneLead: A team has at most one lead.
validation.leadCount: The lead slot has exactly one agent.
validation.parallel: Max executors at once must be 1–{{max}}.
validation.timeLimit: The time limit must be 1–{{max}} minutes.
validation.budget: The budget must be a non-negative number.
validation.hierarchy: The hierarchy needs a lead and at least one executor (not a reviewer).

erp.name: ERP Team
erp.description: Business modules (accounting, payroll, inventory): an architect lead splits each feature for backend and database engineers; QA tests, a reviewer checks.

web.name: Web Team
web.description: Web applications: frontend and backend engineers with a UI/UX designer under an architect lead; QA and a reviewer close each feature.

mobile.name: Mobile Team
mobile.description: Mobile apps: client and API engineers under an architect lead, with QA and review.

security.name: Security Team
security.description: Security audits and fixes: security reviewers and a researcher; every result is reviewed.

rapid.name: Rapid Prototype Team
rapid.description: Fast prototypes: a backend and a frontend engineer, no review step.
